items.title: 68097_Freddie Green oral history interview
items.q: But, I stayed out of the way -- now, because Jo Jones and Walter Page and Basie was doing something else.

ctx.x: Well, Freddie -- I mean -- that must have been -- I mean -- that really -- that was a rhythm section like there's never been a rhythm section like That in a band before.
I know, you know. But, I stayed out of the way -- now, because Jo Jones and Walter Page and Basie was doing something else. You see, I think --
You didn't stay out of the way -- you fell right in with them.
